core_analysis_cohort.complete_case_rule: The single trial with missing liking is excluded for both outcomes so all core models use identical rows.

context_analysis_cohort.context_source: EDF annotation TypeIDs combined with the published paired three-trial block design

models.M1_nominal: emotion category in the core cohort; context is constant where independently unresolved
models.M3_affective_nominal: eight continuous affective predictors plus nominal predictors available for the analysis

robustness_analyses: bidirectional imagery-video transfer in the context-recovered cohort

personalization.support_gate: positive lower 95% CI for global-MAE minus personalized-MAE and positive pooled personalized-minus-global R2 at both k=20 and k=30

trait_stability.partially_stable_family: at least half of constituent traits meet the stability descriptor

interpretation_boundaries: same-trial psychometric reconstruction rather than prospective prediction
within-dataset validation rather than external validation
descriptive model-implied surfaces rather than causal effects
